WITH order_payments_by_order AS (
    SELECT
        op.order_id AS order_id,
        ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS order_sales_amount
    FROM order_payments op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
),
customer_role AS (
    SELECT
        'customer' AS role,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
        ABS(SUM(COALESCE(po.order_sales_amount, 0))) AS total_sales
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_payments_by_order po
        ON po.order_id = o.order_id
),
seller_role AS (
    SELECT
        'seller' AS role,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS total_orders,
        ABS(SUM(COALESCE(oi.price, 0) + COALESCE(oi.freight_value, 0))) AS total_sales
    FROM order_items oi
)
SELECT
    r.role AS role,
    CAST(SUM(r.total_orders) AS BIGINT) AS total_orders,
    CAST(ABS(SUM(r.total_sales)) AS DOUBLE) AS total_sales
FROM (
    SELECT role, total_orders, total_sales FROM customer_role
    UNION ALL
    SELECT role, total_orders, total_sales FROM seller_role
) r
GROUP BY r.role
ORDER BY r.role;
